prompts.st_bunny: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium die-cut digital journal sticker, ONE object composition on genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Hand-painted gouache and delicate colored-pencil illustration, cozy refined stationery shop aesthetic, tiny crafted details but clear readable silhouette at 80px. Off-white continuous die-cut paper border (about 3% of object width), subtle paper grain within the sticker and very faint under-paper shadow. Center the whole sticker on a square canvas with 12% transparent margin on every side. Not an icon, not an emoji, not a photograph. No lettering, no watermark, no checkerboard, no other objects outside the single connected sticker silhouette. Subject: A tiny cream bunny gardening, seated beside a terracotta pot of strawberries, sage gardening hat, little botanical details.
